physicalNotes: Radius: Alderamin is a rapid rotator: Zhao et al. (2009), ApJ 701, 209 measure an equatorial radius of 2.74 and a polar radius of 2.162 solar radii with CHARA/MIRC. The record's radius is the volume-equivalent sphere of those two, 2.53 solar radii; the scene draws the measured flattening, with the equatorial radius on the outline. Adopted 1,761,466 km, 2.5319 solar radii at 695700 km per solar radius. No gravitational parameter is adopted. presentationUp: the display axis, the measured rotation pole, is up.
